annotator: fakechris (proto draft — needs second annotator + adjudication)
purpose: P0 golden proto v2: 5 sessions annotated with the request-intent layering rule (high-level requirement vs detail work directive). Task boundaries are subjective; report inter-annotator agreement before trusting any metric.

intentLayering.note: Semantic judgement performed by the LLM (few-shot), NOT a rule keyword list — object-domain relevance ('is pnpm an env tool or the product core?') depends on workspace context, and a keyword list breaks outside this repo. Rules only filter source.kind and validate outputs. This block doubles as the few-shot exemplar set for the LLM.
intentLayering.requirement: High-level goal/problem/investigation with an independently verifiable deliverable — issue/epic candidate. e.g. '回到我们的目标', '提取质量不高，想清楚这件事', '研究官方有没有 branch from this', bug reports describing a problem.
intentLayering.directive: Detail-level work instruction — concrete operation (fork/restart/commit/pr/push/install/configure/build/clone/submit/continue). NOT an issue by itself; it is a step toward some requirement. e.g. '帮我提交吧', '你来试一次重启', '继续查'.
intentLayering.interruption: User interruption/correction ('你搞砸了', '不对'). A signal (acceptance feedback, requirement change, blocker) — only becomes a new issue if it articulates a new independently verifiable goal.
intentLayering.objectDomainRelevance: Deciding factor for install/configure-style verbs: does the object belong to the product core domain (turtle-ui, harness components, project deps → requirement) or the environment domain (pnpm/git/node/brew → not an issue)? Assessed by the LLM from workspace context, not a hardcoded list.
boundaryCases: '帮我安装配置turtle-ui' — requirement-leaning: turtle-ui is a product-domain object (dsh's TUI client), so installing/configuring it advances the product goal and may be an independent issue candidate (also serves the TUI research task).
'安装配置 pnpm/git' — environment-domain object (generic dev tooling), NOT an issue; pure environment prep.
'更新 issue #514 表述' / '补一条评论' — directives that belong to the bug-fix task they serve.
'重启失败、session 挂掉' — a problem report (could be an issue), distinct from the directive '你来试一次重启' (not an issue).

notes: Task = independently-verifiable deliverable; a directive is never a task by itself.
session-a057ec58 and session-8afdc9d1 are fork copies: identical event sequences. Both are annotated with the SAME 3 tasks; the dedup assertion treats them as one task set.

ad53353c: seq182559-235265 previously annotated as a separate ops task; revised — the restart directive is execution detail of the implementation task, and '重启失败' is acceptance feedback, so it folds into task 7 as evidence, not a standalone issue.
